args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all regions now report v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback action taken.

Note: v2.3.1 was never healthy in production, so if it's ever redeployed it would require change-manager approval per policy.
